tricks.name: Sole Grind (Soul)
tricks.description: A fundamental grind where the dominant skate rests flat on its outer soleplate while the other skate slides on its frame channel.

tricks.name: Acid Grind
tricks.description: A sole grind variation where the front foot turns outward in an acid stance while the back foot grinds on the soleplate.

tricks.name: Mizu Grind (Mizou)
tricks.description: A classic grind where the front foot slides on the soleplate turned inward and the back foot slides on the frame channel.

tricks.name: Makio Grind (W/ Grab)
tricks.description: A stylish one-footed grind performed solely on the soleplate of one skate while grabbing or holding the free skate.

tricks.name: Frontside Grind
tricks.description: The foundation of frame slides where both skates grind on their h-blocks facing forward toward the obstacle.

tricks.name: Backside Grind
tricks.description: A frame slide where both skates grind on the h-blocks with the skater's back turned toward the obstacle.

tricks.name: Front Unity
tricks.description: A frame slide where the skater crosses their legs, placing the front foot behind the back foot on the h-block facing forward.

tricks.name: Backside Unity
tricks.description: A crossed-leg frame slide performed with the skater's back facing toward the ledge or rails.

tricks.name: Savannah
tricks.description: An advanced Unity grind entered by spinning 180 degrees into the crossed-leg slide position.

tricks.name: Royale
tricks.description: A groove slide where both skates angle heavily into the h-blocks, sliding on the frame sides.

tricks.name: Backslide
tricks.description: A one-footed groove slide performed on the back foot h-block with deep knee bend, popular on freestyle frames.

tricks.name: Front Fastslide
tricks.description: A one-footed groove slide performed on the front foot h-block pushing forward along the obstacle.

tricks.name: Negative Sole Grind
tricks.description: A sole grind variant using the inside negative plate of the skate rather than the outer soleplate.

tricks.name: Negative Acid Grind
tricks.description: An Acid grind variant executed using the inside negative grinding area of the boot.

tricks.name: Negative Makio Grind
tricks.description: A single-foot grind balancing on the inside negative plate of the skate boot.

tricks.name: Top Sole (Top Soul)
tricks.description: A sole grind executed over the top of the rails or ledge, locking the boot on top of the surface coping.

tricks.name: Topside Acid (Top Acid)
tricks.description: An Acid grind where the sole boot locks over the top edge of the rails or obstacle.

tricks.name: Sweatstance (Topside Mizu)
tricks.description: A topside Mizu grind where the front sole foot locks over the top of the obstacle rails.

tricks.name: Fishbrain
tricks.description: A single-foot topside grind balancing over the top of the ledge or rails on the soleplate while grabbing the free skate.

tricks.name: Alley-Oop Sole (AO Soul)
tricks.description: A sole grind where the skater spins 180 degrees forward into the obstacle, grinding backward.

tricks.name: Kind Grind
tricks.description: An Alley-Oop Topside Mizu grind, combining a forward 180 spin with a topside Mizu lock.

tricks.name: True Spin Sole (Soul)
tricks.description: A sole grind entered by spinning 180 degrees blind turning back toward the obstacle.

tricks.name: Zero Spin Sole (Soul)
tricks.description: Approaching the obstacle rolling backward and locking directly into a backward grind without spinning.

tricks.name: In-Spin 270 Frontside
tricks.description: Spinning 270 degrees with chest turning toward the rails into a frontside h-block grind.

tricks.name: Out-Spin 270 Frontside
tricks.description: Spinning 270 degrees with back turning toward the rails into a frontside h-block grind.

tricks.name: Illusion In-Spin Grind
tricks.description: A rotational entry where the head and shoulders turn opposite to the rotation direction.

tricks.name: Hurricane Top Sole
tricks.description: A full 360-degree in-spin rotation going forward directly into a topside sole grind position.

tricks.name: Switch Front Side
tricks.description: Executing a Frontside h-block grind in switch stance with the non-dominant foot leading.

tricks.name: Front UFO
tricks.description: A groove grind where both feet are angled outward in a wide duck stance on the h-blocks facing forward.

tricks.name: Switch Front UFO
tricks.description: Executing a Front UFO groove grind in opposite non-dominant stance.

tricks.name: Switch Sole (Soul)
tricks.description: A Soul grind performed in switch stance with the opposite skate resting on the soleplate.

tricks.name: Switch Acid
tricks.description: An Acid grind performed in switch stance with opposite foot positioning.

tricks.name: Switch Makio (W/ Grab)
tricks.description: A one-footed Makio grind executed on the non-dominant soleplate while grabbing the free skate.

tricks.name: AO (Alley Oop) Unity
tricks.description: Spinning 180 degrees forward into a crossed-leg Unity frame slide.

tricks.name: Switch Back Side
tricks.description: A Backside h-block grind executed in switch stance with back facing the obstacle.

tricks.name: X Grind
tricks.description: A grind where both skates form an X shape, with one foot on the soleplate and the other on the inner frame.

tricks.name: Topside X Grind
tricks.description: An X Grind executed over the top edge of the ledge or rails coping.

tricks.name: Back Side Back Slide
tricks.description: A Backslide performed facing away from the obstacle on the rear h-block.

tricks.name: Switch AO Soul
tricks.description: An Alley-Oop Soul grind executed in non-dominant switch stance.

tricks.name: AO Pornstar
tricks.description: An Alley-Oop entry into a pornstar stance grind with feet angled outwards.

tricks.name: Switch AO Pornstar
tricks.description: An Alley-Oop pornstar grind executed in switch stance.

tricks.name: Switch Top Soul
tricks.description: A Topside Soul grind executed in switch stance over the top coping.

tricks.name: Switch Top Acid
tricks.description: A Topside Acid grind executed in switch stance over the obstacle.

tricks.name: Switch Front Fast Slide
tricks.description: A Fastslide performed on the non-dominant front foot h-block.

tricks.name: 270 Back Farv
tricks.description: Spinning 270 degrees into a Backside Farvarnagen groove slide.

tricks.name: 270 Back Royal
tricks.description: Spinning 270 degrees into a Backside Royale groove slide.

tricks.name: AO Acid
tricks.description: An Alley-Oop rotation entering directly into an Acid grind stance.

tricks.name: AO X-Grind
tricks.description: An Alley-Oop 180 spin entering directly into an X Grind position.

tricks.name: Misfit
tricks.description: A variation combining a topside sole foot with a back foot acid stance across the ledge.

tricks.name: AO Makio
tricks.description: An Alley-Oop 180 spin into a single-footed Makio sole grind while holding a grab.

tricks.name: True Spin Makio
tricks.description: An true spin 180 into a single-footed Makio sole grind while holding a grab.

tricks.name: Front Torque (Freestyle)
tricks.description: A frontside torque groove slide leaning heavily on the back skate h-block.

tricks.name: Back Torque (Freestyle)
tricks.description: A backside torque groove slide with back to the obstacle leaning into the frame notch.

tricks.name: Top Side Pornstar
tricks.description: A Star Pornstar grind positioning locked over the top coping of a rails or ledge.

tricks.name: Switch Top Side Pornstar
tricks.description: A Topside Pornstar grind executed in switch stance.

tricks.name: True Spin Top Side Soul
tricks.description: A blind 180 spin turning back toward the rails directly locking into a Topside Soul grind.
